parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: The personal access token. This parameter is not required if you use an AccessKey pair or STS temporary authorization for authentication.

parameters.name: keyId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the ssh key.

parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: The ID of the organization. You can find the organization ID in the URL of the organization page on Alibaba Cloud DevOps. For example, in `https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/{organizationId}`, `{organizationId}` is the organization ID.
